Q1a.en: A function is one-one when equal images force equal inputs, and onto when every real number is an image. If \(f(x_1) = f(x_2)\), then \(3x_1 + 5 = 3x_2 + 5\), so \(x_1 = x_2\) and \(f\) is one-one. For any real \(y\), the number \(x = \frac{y - 5}{3}\) is real and \(f(x) = y\), so \(f\) is onto. Hence the answer is the choice: \(f\) is one-one onto.
Q1a.hi: यदि \(f(x_1) = f(x_2)\) हो, तो \(3x_1 + 5 = 3x_2 + 5\), अतः \(x_1 = x_2\); इसलिए \(f\) एकैकी है। किसी भी वास्तविक संख्या \(y\) के लिए \(x = \frac{y - 5}{3}\) वास्तविक है और \(f(x) = y\), इसलिए \(f\) आच्छादक है। अतः सही विकल्प है: \(f\) एकैकी आच्छादक है।

Q1b.en: Use the principal value branches. \(\tan^{-1}(\sqrt{3}) = \frac{\pi}{3}\). Since \(\cot^{-1}\) takes values in \((0, \pi)\), \(\cot^{-1}(-\sqrt{3}) = \pi - \cot^{-1}(\sqrt{3}) = \pi - \frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{5\pi}{6}\). So the value is \(\frac{\pi}{3} - \frac{5\pi}{6} = -\frac{\pi}{2}\), which is the choice \(\frac{-\pi}{2}\).
Q1b.hi: मुख्य मान शाखाओं का प्रयोग करने पर \(\tan^{-1}(\sqrt{3}) = \frac{\pi}{3}\)। चूँकि \(\cot^{-1}\) का परिसर \((0, \pi)\) है, इसलिए \(\cot^{-1}(-\sqrt{3}) = \pi - \cot^{-1}(\sqrt{3}) = \pi - \frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{5\pi}{6}\)। अतः मान \(\frac{\pi}{3} - \frac{5\pi}{6} = -\frac{\pi}{2}\) है, जो विकल्प \(\frac{-\pi}{2}\) है।

Q1c.en: Multiplying a matrix by a scalar \(K\) multiplies every entry by \(K\), and taking the transpose only interchanges rows and columns, so the scalar stays outside: \((KA)' = KA'\). The answer is the choice \(KA'\).
Q1c.hi: किसी आव्यूह को अचर \(K\) से गुणा करने पर प्रत्येक अवयव \(K\) से गुणा हो जाता है, और परिवर्त लेने पर केवल पंक्तियाँ और स्तम्भ परस्पर बदलते हैं, अतः अचर बाहर ही रहता है: \((KA)' = KA'\)। सही विकल्प \(KA'\) है।

Q1d.en: The area of a circle is \(\pi r^2\), so its rate of change with respect to the radius is \(\frac{d}{dr}(\pi r^2) = 2\pi r\). At \(r = 6\) cm this is \(2\pi \times 6 = 12\pi\) cm\(^2\)/cm, which is the choice \(12\pi\).
Q1d.hi: वृत्त का क्षेत्रफल \(\pi r^2\) है, अतः त्रिज्या के सापेक्ष इसके परिवर्तन की दर \(\frac{d}{dr}(\pi r^2) = 2\pi r\) है। \(r = 6\) cm पर यह \(2\pi \times 6 = 12\pi\) cm\(^2\)/cm है, जो विकल्प \(12\pi\) है।

Q1e.en: Write \(4 + 9x^2 = 9\left(\left(\frac{2}{3}\right)^2 + x^2\right)\). Then \(\int \frac{dx}{4 + 9x^2} = \frac{1}{9} \cdot \frac{3}{2}\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{3x}{2}\right) = \frac{1}{6}\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{3x}{2}\right)\). So the integral is \(\frac{1}{6}\left[\tan^{-1}(1) - \tan^{-1}(0)\right] = \frac{1}{6} \cdot \frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{\pi}{24}\), which is the choice \(\frac{\pi}{24}\).
Q1e.hi: \(4 + 9x^2 = 9\left(\left(\frac{2}{3}\right)^2 + x^2\right)\) लिखने पर \(\int \frac{dx}{4 + 9x^2} = \frac{1}{9} \cdot \frac{3}{2}\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{3x}{2}\right) = \frac{1}{6}\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{3x}{2}\right)\)। अतः समाकल का मान \(\frac{1}{6}\left[\tan^{-1}(1) - \tan^{-1}(0)\right] = \frac{1}{6} \cdot \frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{\pi}{24}\) है, जो विकल्प \(\frac{\pi}{24}\) है।

Q2a.en: Let \(f(x) = x^3 + x\cos x\). Then \(f(-x) = -x^3 - x\cos x = -f(x)\), so \(f\) is an odd function. The integral of an odd function over \([-a, a]\) is zero, hence \(\int_{\frac{-\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} (x^3 + x\cos x)\, dx = 0\).
Q2a.hi: माना \(f(x) = x^3 + x\cos x\)। तब \(f(-x) = -x^3 - x\cos x = -f(x)\), अतः \(f\) एक विषम फलन है। विषम फलन का \([-a, a]\) पर समाकल शून्य होता है, इसलिए \(\int_{\frac{-\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} (x^3 + x\cos x)\, dx = 0\)।

Q2b.en:
\(\sin x \geq 0\) on \([0, \pi]\) and \(\sin x \leq 0\) on \([\pi, 2\pi]\), so the area is the sum of the two parts taken positive.
\(\int_{0}^{\pi} \sin x\, dx = [-\cos x]_{0}^{\pi} = 1 + 1 = 2\) and \(\int_{\pi}^{2\pi} \sin x\, dx = [-\cos x]_{\pi}^{2\pi} = -1 - 1 = -2\).
Area \(= 2 + |-2| = 4\) square units.
Q2b.hi:
\([0, \pi]\) पर \(\sin x \geq 0\) तथा \([\pi, 2\pi]\) पर \(\sin x \leq 0\) है, अतः क्षेत्रफल दोनों भागों के धनात्मक मानों का योग है।
\(\int_{0}^{\pi} \sin x\, dx = [-\cos x]_{0}^{\pi} = 1 + 1 = 2\) तथा \(\int_{\pi}^{2\pi} \sin x\, dx = [-\cos x]_{\pi}^{2\pi} = -1 - 1 = -2\)।
क्षेत्रफल \(= 2 + |-2| = 4\) वर्ग इकाई।

Q2c.en: The highest order derivative present is \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2}\), so the order is 2. The equation contains \(\sin\left(\frac{dy}{dx}\right)\), so it is not a polynomial in the derivatives; hence its degree is not defined.
Q2c.hi: समीकरण में उपस्थित उच्चतम कोटि का अवकलज \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2}\) है, अतः कोटि 2 है। समीकरण में \(\sin\left(\frac{dy}{dx}\right)\) पद है, इसलिए यह अवकलजों में बहुपद नहीं है; अतः इसकी घात परिभाषित नहीं है।

Q2d.en:
The area of the parallelogram is \(|\vec{a} \times \vec{b}|\).
\(\vec{a} \times \vec{b} = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 3 & 1 & 4 \\ 1 & -1 & 1 \end{vmatrix} = \hat{i}(1 + 4) - \hat{j}(3 - 4) + \hat{k}(-3 - 1) = 5\hat{i} + \hat{j} - 4\hat{k}\)
Area \(= \sqrt{25 + 1 + 16} = \sqrt{42}\) square units.
Q2d.hi:
समान्तर चतुर्भुज का क्षेत्रफल \(|\vec{a} \times \vec{b}|\) होता है।
\(\vec{a} \times \vec{b} = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 3 & 1 & 4 \\ 1 & -1 & 1 \end{vmatrix} = \hat{i}(1 + 4) - \hat{j}(3 - 4) + \hat{k}(-3 - 1) = 5\hat{i} + \hat{j} - 4\hat{k}\)
क्षेत्रफल \(= \sqrt{25 + 1 + 16} = \sqrt{42}\) वर्ग इकाई।

Q2e.en: Since \(I\) commutes with \(A\), \((I + A)^2 = I^2 + 2A + A^2 = I + 2A + A = I + 3A\), using \(A^2 = A\). Hence \((I + A)^2 - 7A = I + 3A - 7A = I - 4A\).

Q3a.en:
Two ordered pairs are equal when their first components are equal and their second components are equal.
So \(2x - 3 = x\), which gives \(x = 3\); and \(y - 1 = -5\), which gives \(y = -4\).
Hence \(x = 3\) and \(y = -4\).
Q3a.hi:
दो क्रमित युग्म तभी बराबर होते हैं जब उनके प्रथम घटक परस्पर बराबर हों और द्वितीय घटक परस्पर बराबर हों।
अतः \(2x - 3 = x\), जिससे \(x = 3\); तथा \(y - 1 = -5\), जिससे \(y = -4\)।
अतः \(x = 3\) और \(y = -4\)।

Q3b.en:
A function is continuous at \(x = 3\) if \(\lim_{x \to 3} f(x) = f(3)\).
\(f(3) = 2(3)^2 - 1 = 17\) and \(\lim_{x \to 3} (2x^2 - 1) = 2(9) - 1 = 17\).
Since \(\lim_{x \to 3} f(x) = f(3)\), the function is continuous at \(x = 3\).

Q3c.en:
Let \(y = \log(\log x)\). By the chain rule,
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{1}{\log x} \cdot \frac{d}{dx}(\log x) = \frac{1}{\log x} \cdot \frac{1}{x} = \frac{1}{x \log x}, \quad x > 1\).
Q3c.hi:
माना \(y = \log(\log x)\)। श्रृंखला नियम से,
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{1}{\log x} \cdot \frac{d}{dx}(\log x) = \frac{1}{\log x} \cdot \frac{1}{x} = \frac{1}{x \log x}, \quad x > 1\)।

Q3d.en:
Here \(f(x) = e^{2x}\), so \(f'(x) = 2e^{2x}\).
For every real \(x\), \(e^{2x} > 0\), so \(f'(x) = 2e^{2x} > 0\) on \(R\).
Hence \(f\) is (strictly) increasing on \(R\).

Q4a.en:
Expand the left side using the distributive law of the dot product and \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = \vec{b} \cdot \vec{a}\):
\((\vec{a} + \vec{b}) \cdot (\vec{a} + \vec{b}) = \vec{a} \cdot \vec{a} + \vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{a} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{b} = |\vec{a}|^2 + 2\,\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + |\vec{b}|^2\) ...(1)
If \(\vec{a}\) and \(\vec{b}\) are perpendicular, then \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = 0\), and (1) gives \((\vec{a} + \vec{b}) \cdot (\vec{a} + \vec{b}) = |\vec{a}|^2 + |\vec{b}|^2\).
Conversely, if \((\vec{a} + \vec{b}) \cdot (\vec{a} + \vec{b}) = |\vec{a}|^2 + |\vec{b}|^2\), then by (1), \(2\,\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = 0\), i.e. \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = 0\). Since \(\vec{a} \neq \vec{0}\) and \(\vec{b} \neq \vec{0}\), the vectors are perpendicular.
Hence the equality holds if and only if \(\vec{a}\) and \(\vec{b}\) are perpendicular.
Q4a.hi:
अदिश गुणनफल के वितरण नियम तथा \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = \vec{b} \cdot \vec{a}\) से,
\((\vec{a} + \vec{b}) \cdot (\vec{a} + \vec{b}) = \vec{a} \cdot \vec{a} + \vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{a} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{b} = |\vec{a}|^2 + 2\,\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + |\vec{b}|^2\) ...(1)
यदि \(\vec{a}\) तथा \(\vec{b}\) लम्बवत हैं, तो \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = 0\), और (1) से \((\vec{a} + \vec{b}) \cdot (\vec{a} + \vec{b}) = |\vec{a}|^2 + |\vec{b}|^2\)।
विलोमतः, यदि \((\vec{a} + \vec{b}) \cdot (\vec{a} + \vec{b}) = |\vec{a}|^2 + |\vec{b}|^2\), तो (1) से \(2\,\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = 0\), अर्थात \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = 0\)। चूँकि \(\vec{a} \neq \vec{0}\) तथा \(\vec{b} \neq \vec{0}\), अतः दोनों सदिश लम्बवत हैं।
अतः समिका तभी और केवल तभी सत्य है जब \(\vec{a}\) तथा \(\vec{b}\) लम्बवत हों।

Q4b.en:
The direction cosines of a line are the cosines of the angles it makes with the \(x\), \(y\) and \(z\) axes.
The \(x\)-axis makes angles \(0, \frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\) with the three axes, so its direction cosines are \(\cos 0, \cos\frac{\pi}{2}, \cos\frac{\pi}{2}\), i.e. \(1, 0, 0\).
Similarly, the direction cosines of the \(y\)-axis are \(0, 1, 0\) and of the \(z\)-axis are \(0, 0, 1\).
Q4b.hi:
किसी रेखा की दिक्-कोसाइन वे कोसाइन मान हैं जो उसके \(x\), \(y\) तथा \(z\)-अक्षों के साथ बने कोणों के होते हैं।
\(x\)-अक्ष तीनों अक्षों के साथ क्रमशः \(0, \frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\) कोण बनाता है, अतः उसकी दिक्-कोसाइन \(\cos 0, \cos\frac{\pi}{2}, \cos\frac{\pi}{2}\), अर्थात \(1, 0, 0\) हैं।
इसी प्रकार \(y\)-अक्ष की दिक्-कोसाइन \(0, 1, 0\) तथा \(z\)-अक्ष की दिक्-कोसाइन \(0, 0, 1\) हैं।

Q4c.en:
By the definition of conditional probability,
\(P(A / B) = \frac{P(A \cap B)}{P(B)} = \frac{\frac{4}{13}}{\frac{9}{13}} = \frac{4}{9}\).
Q4c.hi:
सप्रतिबंध प्रायिकता की परिभाषा से,
\(P(A / B) = \frac{P(A \cap B)}{P(B)} = \frac{\frac{4}{13}}{\frac{9}{13}} = \frac{4}{9}\)।

Q4d.en:
Use \(\cos^2 x = \frac{1 + \cos 2x}{2}\):
\(\int \cos^2 x\, dx = \frac{1}{2}\int (1 + \cos 2x)\, dx = \frac{1}{2}\left(x + \frac{\sin 2x}{2}\right) + C = \frac{x}{2} + \frac{\sin 2x}{4} + C\).
Q4d.hi:
\(\cos^2 x = \frac{1 + \cos 2x}{2}\) का प्रयोग करने पर,
\(\int \cos^2 x\, dx = \frac{1}{2}\int (1 + \cos 2x)\, dx = \frac{1}{2}\left(x + \frac{\sin 2x}{2}\right) + C = \frac{x}{2} + \frac{\sin 2x}{4} + C\)।

Q5b.en:
Given \(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c} = \vec{0}\). Take the dot product of each side with itself:
\((\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}) \cdot (\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}) = 0\)
\(\Rightarrow |\vec{a}|^2 + |\vec{b}|^2 + |\vec{c}|^2 + 2(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a}) = 0\)
Substituting \(|\vec{a}| = 3\), \(|\vec{b}| = 4\), \(|\vec{c}| = 5\):
\(9 + 16 + 25 + 2(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a}) = 0\)
\(\Rightarrow 2(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a}) = -50\)
Hence \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a} = -25\).
Q5b.hi:
दिया है \(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c} = \vec{0}\)। दोनों पक्षों का स्वयं से अदिश गुणनफल लेने पर,
\((\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}) \cdot (\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}) = 0\)
\(\Rightarrow |\vec{a}|^2 + |\vec{b}|^2 + |\vec{c}|^2 + 2(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a}) = 0\)
\(|\vec{a}| = 3\), \(|\vec{b}| = 4\), \(|\vec{c}| = 5\) रखने पर,
\(9 + 16 + 25 + 2(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a}) = 0\)
\(\Rightarrow 2(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a}) = -50\)
अतः \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a} = -25\)।

Q5c.en:
The angle between two lines \(\vec{r} = \vec{a}_1 + \lambda \vec{b}_1\) and \(\vec{r} = \vec{a}_2 + \mu \vec{b}_2\) is given by \(\cos\theta = \left|\frac{\vec{b}_1 \cdot \vec{b}_2}{|\vec{b}_1||\vec{b}_2|}\right|\).
Here \(\vec{b}_1 = \hat{i} + 2\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}\) and \(\vec{b}_2 = 3\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} + 6\hat{k}\).
\(\vec{b}_1 \cdot \vec{b}_2 = 1(3) + 2(2) + 2(6) = 3 + 4 + 12 = 19\)
\(|\vec{b}_1| = \sqrt{1 + 4 + 4} = 3\), \(|\vec{b}_2| = \sqrt{9 + 4 + 36} = 7\)
\(\cos\theta = \frac{19}{3 \times 7} = \frac{19}{21}\)
Hence the angle between the lines is \(\theta = \cos^{-1}\left(\frac{19}{21}\right)\).
Q5c.hi:
रेखाओं \(\vec{r} = \vec{a}_1 + \lambda \vec{b}_1\) तथा \(\vec{r} = \vec{a}_2 + \mu \vec{b}_2\) के बीच का कोण \(\cos\theta = \left|\frac{\vec{b}_1 \cdot \vec{b}_2}{|\vec{b}_1||\vec{b}_2|}\right|\) से प्राप्त होता है।
यहाँ \(\vec{b}_1 = \hat{i} + 2\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}\) तथा \(\vec{b}_2 = 3\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} + 6\hat{k}\)।
\(\vec{b}_1 \cdot \vec{b}_2 = 1(3) + 2(2) + 2(6) = 3 + 4 + 12 = 19\)
\(|\vec{b}_1| = \sqrt{1 + 4 + 4} = 3\), \(|\vec{b}_2| = \sqrt{9 + 4 + 36} = 7\)
\(\cos\theta = \frac{19}{3 \times 7} = \frac{19}{21}\)
अतः रेखाओं के मध्य कोण \(\theta = \cos^{-1}\left(\frac{19}{21}\right)\) है।

Q5d.en:
Draw the lines of the constraints in the first quadrant (\(x \geq 0, y \geq 0\)).
The line \(x + y = 8\) passes through \((8, 0)\) and \((0, 8)\). Since \((0, 0)\) does not satisfy \(x + y \geq 8\) (\(0 \geq 8\) is false), this constraint is the half plane away from the origin.
The line \(3x + 5y = 15\) passes through \((5, 0)\) and \((0, 3)\). Since \((0, 0)\) satisfies \(3x + 5y \leq 15\), this constraint is the side containing the origin: with \(x, y \geq 0\) it is the triangle with vertices \((0, 0)\), \((5, 0)\) and \((0, 3)\).
Every point of that triangle has \(x + y \leq 5\) (for \(x, y \geq 0\), \(x + y \leq \frac{3x + 5y}{3} \leq \frac{15}{3} = 5\)), so no point of it satisfies \(x + y \geq 8\). On the graph the two shaded regions do not overlap.
Hence there is no feasible region, i.e. no point satisfies all the constraints. The problem has no feasible solution, so \(z = 3x + 2y\) has no minimum value under these constraints.
Q5d.hi:
प्रथम चतुर्थांश (\(x \geq 0, y \geq 0\)) में व्यवरोधों की रेखाएँ खींचते हैं।
रेखा \(x + y = 8\) बिंदुओं \((8, 0)\) तथा \((0, 8)\) से होकर जाती है। \((0, 0)\) असमिका \(x + y \geq 8\) को संतुष्ट नहीं करता (\(0 \geq 8\) असत्य है), अतः यह व्यवरोध मूलबिंदु से दूर वाला अर्धतल है।
रेखा \(3x + 5y = 15\) बिंदुओं \((5, 0)\) तथा \((0, 3)\) से होकर जाती है। \((0, 0)\) असमिका \(3x + 5y \leq 15\) को संतुष्ट करता है, अतः यह व्यवरोध मूलबिंदु वाला भाग है; \(x, y \geq 0\) के साथ यह शीर्षों \((0, 0)\), \((5, 0)\) तथा \((0, 3)\) वाला त्रिभुज है।
इस त्रिभुज के प्रत्येक बिंदु के लिए \(x + y \leq 5\) है (\(x, y \geq 0\) के लिए \(x + y \leq \frac{3x + 5y}{3} \leq \frac{15}{3} = 5\)), अतः इसका कोई भी बिंदु \(x + y \geq 8\) को संतुष्ट नहीं करता। ग्राफ पर दोनों छायांकित क्षेत्र एक-दूसरे को नहीं काटते।
अतः कोई सुसंगत क्षेत्र नहीं है, अर्थात कोई भी बिंदु सभी व्यवरोधों को संतुष्ट नहीं करता। समस्या का कोई सुसंगत हल नहीं है, इसलिए इन व्यवरोधों के अन्तर्गत \(z = 3x + 2y\) का कोई न्यूनतम मान नहीं है।

Q5e.en:
First find the product of the matrices \(A\) and \(B\):
\(AB = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & 3 \\ 1 & -4 \end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix} 1 & -2 \\ -1 & 3 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 2 - 3 & -4 + 9 \\ 1 + 4 & -2 - 12 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} -1 & 5 \\ 5 & -14 \end{bmatrix}\)
\(|AB| = (-1)(-14) - (5)(5) = 14 - 25 = -11 \neq 0\), so \((AB)^{-1}\) exists.
The cofactors of \(AB\) are \(C_{11} = -14\), \(C_{12} = -5\), \(C_{21} = -5\), \(C_{22} = -1\), so
\(\text{adj}(AB) = \begin{bmatrix} -14 & -5 \\ -5 & -1 \end{bmatrix}\)
\((AB)^{-1} = \frac{1}{|AB|}\,\text{adj}(AB) = -\frac{1}{11}\begin{bmatrix} -14 & -5 \\ -5 & -1 \end{bmatrix} = \frac{1}{11}\begin{bmatrix} 14 & 5 \\ 5 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\)
Check by \((AB)^{-1} = B^{-1}A^{-1}\): \(|A| = -8 - 3 = -11\), \(A^{-1} = \frac{1}{11}\begin{bmatrix} 4 & 3 \\ 1 & -2 \end{bmatrix}\); \(|B| = 3 - 2 = 1\), \(B^{-1} = \begin{bmatrix} 3 & 2 \\ 1 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\); \(B^{-1}A^{-1} = \frac{1}{11}\begin{bmatrix} 12 + 2 & 9 - 4 \\ 4 + 1 & 3 - 2 \end{bmatrix} = \frac{1}{11}\begin{bmatrix} 14 & 5 \\ 5 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\), the same.
Hence \((AB)^{-1} = \frac{1}{11}\begin{bmatrix} 14 & 5 \\ 5 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\).
Q5e.hi:
पहले आव्यूहों \(A\) तथा \(B\) का गुणनफल ज्ञात करते हैं:
\(AB = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & 3 \\ 1 & -4 \end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix} 1 & -2 \\ -1 & 3 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 2 - 3 & -4 + 9 \\ 1 + 4 & -2 - 12 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} -1 & 5 \\ 5 & -14 \end{bmatrix}\)
\(|AB| = (-1)(-14) - (5)(5) = 14 - 25 = -11 \neq 0\), अतः \((AB)^{-1}\) का अस्तित्व है।
\(AB\) के सहखंड \(C_{11} = -14\), \(C_{12} = -5\), \(C_{21} = -5\), \(C_{22} = -1\) हैं, अतः
\(\text{adj}(AB) = \begin{bmatrix} -14 & -5 \\ -5 & -1 \end{bmatrix}\)
\((AB)^{-1} = \frac{1}{|AB|}\,\text{adj}(AB) = -\frac{1}{11}\begin{bmatrix} -14 & -5 \\ -5 & -1 \end{bmatrix} = \frac{1}{11}\begin{bmatrix} 14 & 5 \\ 5 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\)
\((AB)^{-1} = B^{-1}A^{-1}\) से जाँच: \(|A| = -8 - 3 = -11\), \(A^{-1} = \frac{1}{11}\begin{bmatrix} 4 & 3 \\ 1 & -2 \end{bmatrix}\); \(|B| = 3 - 2 = 1\), \(B^{-1} = \begin{bmatrix} 3 & 2 \\ 1 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\); \(B^{-1}A^{-1} = \frac{1}{11}\begin{bmatrix} 12 + 2 & 9 - 4 \\ 4 + 1 & 3 - 2 \end{bmatrix} = \frac{1}{11}\begin{bmatrix} 14 & 5 \\ 5 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\), जो वही है।
अतः \((AB)^{-1} = \frac{1}{11}\begin{bmatrix} 14 & 5 \\ 5 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\)।

Q6a.en:
Write the numerator and denominator as single trigonometric terms:
\(\cos x - \sin x = \sqrt{2}\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\cos x - \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\sin x\right) = \sqrt{2}\left(\sin\frac{\pi}{4}\cos x - \cos\frac{\pi}{4}\sin x\right) = \sqrt{2}\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{4} - x\right)\)
\(\cos x + \sin x = \sqrt{2}\left(\cos\frac{\pi}{4}\cos x + \sin\frac{\pi}{4}\sin x\right) = \sqrt{2}\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{4} - x\right)\)
So \(\frac{\cos x - \sin x}{\cos x + \sin x} = \tan\left(\frac{\pi}{4} - x\right)\).
Since \(\frac{-\pi}{4} < x < \frac{3\pi}{4}\), we get \(-\frac{\pi}{2} < \frac{\pi}{4} - x < \frac{\pi}{2}\), which lies in the principal value branch of \(\tan^{-1}\).
Hence \(\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{\cos x - \sin x}{\cos x + \sin x}\right) = \tan^{-1}\left(\tan\left(\frac{\pi}{4} - x\right)\right) = \frac{\pi}{4} - x\).
Q6a.hi:
अंश और हर को एक-एक त्रिकोणमितीय पद के रूप में लिखते हैं:
\(\cos x - \sin x = \sqrt{2}\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\cos x - \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\sin x\right) = \sqrt{2}\left(\sin\frac{\pi}{4}\cos x - \cos\frac{\pi}{4}\sin x\right) = \sqrt{2}\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{4} - x\right)\)
\(\cos x + \sin x = \sqrt{2}\left(\cos\frac{\pi}{4}\cos x + \sin\frac{\pi}{4}\sin x\right) = \sqrt{2}\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{4} - x\right)\)
अतः \(\frac{\cos x - \sin x}{\cos x + \sin x} = \tan\left(\frac{\pi}{4} - x\right)\)।
चूँकि \(\frac{-\pi}{4} < x < \frac{3\pi}{4}\), इसलिए \(-\frac{\pi}{2} < \frac{\pi}{4} - x < \frac{\pi}{2}\), जो \(\tan^{-1}\) की मुख्य मान शाखा में है।
अतः \(\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{\cos x - \sin x}{\cos x + \sin x}\right) = \tan^{-1}\left(\tan\left(\frac{\pi}{4} - x\right)\right) = \frac{\pi}{4} - x\)।

Q6b.en:
(i) \(f\) is one-one: let \(x_1, x_2 \in \left[0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) with \(f(x_1) = f(x_2)\), i.e. \(\cos x_1 = \cos x_2\). On \(\left[0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\), \(\cos x\) is strictly decreasing (\(\frac{d}{dx}\cos x = -\sin x < 0\) for \(0 < x \leq \frac{\pi}{2}\)), so it takes each value only once. Hence \(x_1 = x_2\), and \(f\) is one-one.
(ii) \(g\) is one-one: let \(g(x_1) = g(x_2)\), i.e. \(\sin x_1 = \sin x_2\) with \(x_1, x_2 \in \left[0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\). On this interval \(\sin x\) is strictly increasing (\(\frac{d}{dx}\sin x = \cos x > 0\) for \(0 \leq x < \frac{\pi}{2}\)), so \(x_1 = x_2\). Hence \(g\) is one-one.
(iii) \(f + g\) is not one-one: \((f + g)(x) = \cos x + \sin x\).
\((f + g)(0) = \cos 0 + \sin 0 = 1 + 0 = 1\) and \((f + g)\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right) = \cos\frac{\pi}{2} + \sin\frac{\pi}{2} = 0 + 1 = 1\).
Thus \(0 \neq \frac{\pi}{2}\) but \((f + g)(0) = (f + g)\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)\), so \(f + g\) is not one-one.
Hence \(f\) and \(g\) are one-one but \(f + g\) is not one-one.
Q6b.hi:
(i) \(f\) एकैकी है: माना \(x_1, x_2 \in \left[0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) तथा \(f(x_1) = f(x_2)\), अर्थात \(\cos x_1 = \cos x_2\)। \(\left[0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) पर \(\cos x\) निरंतर ह्रासमान है (\(0 < x \leq \frac{\pi}{2}\) के लिए \(\frac{d}{dx}\cos x = -\sin x < 0\)), अतः यह प्रत्येक मान केवल एक बार लेता है। इसलिए \(x_1 = x_2\), और \(f\) एकैकी है।
(ii) \(g\) एकैकी है: माना \(x_1, x_2 \in \left[0, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) तथा \(g(x_1) = g(x_2)\), अर्थात \(\sin x_1 = \sin x_2\)। इस अन्तराल पर \(\sin x\) निरंतर वर्धमान है (\(0 \leq x < \frac{\pi}{2}\) के लिए \(\frac{d}{dx}\sin x = \cos x > 0\)), अतः \(x_1 = x_2\)। इसलिए \(g\) एकैकी है।
(iii) \(f + g\) एकैकी नहीं है: \((f + g)(x) = \cos x + \sin x\)।
\((f + g)(0) = \cos 0 + \sin 0 = 1 + 0 = 1\) तथा \((f + g)\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right) = \cos\frac{\pi}{2} + \sin\frac{\pi}{2} = 0 + 1 = 1\)।
इस प्रकार \(0 \neq \frac{\pi}{2}\) परन्तु \((f + g)(0) = (f + g)\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)\), अतः \(f + g\) एकैकी नहीं है।
अतः \(f\) तथा \(g\) एकैकी हैं, किन्तु \(f + g\) एकैकी नहीं है।

Q6c.en:
A function is continuous at \(x = 1\) if the left hand limit, the right hand limit and \(f(1)\) are all equal.
Value of the function: \(f(1) = 1 + 5 = 6\).
Left hand limit: \(\lim_{x \to 1^-} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 1^-} (x + 5) = 1 + 5 = 6\).
Right hand limit: \(\lim_{x \to 1^+} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 1^+} (x - 5) = 1 - 5 = -4\).
Since the left hand limit \(6\) is not equal to the right hand limit \(-4\), \(\lim_{x \to 1} f(x)\) does not exist.
Hence \(f\) is not continuous at \(x = 1\).
Q6c.hi:
फलन \(x = 1\) पर संतत होता है यदि बाएँ पक्ष की सीमा, दाएँ पक्ष की सीमा तथा \(f(1)\) तीनों बराबर हों।
फलन का मान: \(f(1) = 1 + 5 = 6\)।
बाएँ पक्ष की सीमा: \(\lim_{x \to 1^-} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 1^-} (x + 5) = 1 + 5 = 6\)।
दाएँ पक्ष की सीमा: \(\lim_{x \to 1^+} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 1^+} (x - 5) = 1 - 5 = -4\)।
चूँकि बाएँ पक्ष की सीमा \(6\), दाएँ पक्ष की सीमा \(-4\) के बराबर नहीं है, अतः \(\lim_{x \to 1} f(x)\) का अस्तित्व नहीं है।
अतः \(f\), \(x = 1\) पर संतत नहीं है।

Q6d.en:
The shortest distance between the lines \(\vec{r} = \vec{a}_1 + \lambda \vec{b}_1\) and \(\vec{r} = \vec{a}_2 + \mu \vec{b}_2\) is \(d = \left|\frac{(\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2) \cdot (\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1)}{|\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2|}\right|\).
Writing the first line as \(\vec{r} = (\hat{i} + \hat{j}) + \lambda(-2\hat{i} - \hat{j} - \hat{k})\):
\(\vec{a}_1 = \hat{i} + \hat{j}\), \(\vec{b}_1 = -2\hat{i} - \hat{j} - \hat{k}\), \(\vec{a}_2 = 2\hat{i} + \hat{j} + \hat{k}\), \(\vec{b}_2 = 3\hat{i} - 5\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}\).
\(\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1 = \hat{i} + 0\hat{j} + \hat{k}\)
\(\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2 = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ -2 & -1 & -1 \\ 3 & -5 & 2 \end{vmatrix} = \hat{i}(-2 - 5) - \hat{j}(-4 + 3) + \hat{k}(10 + 3) = -7\hat{i} + \hat{j} + 13\hat{k}\)
\(|\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2| = \sqrt{49 + 1 + 169} = \sqrt{219}\)
\((\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2) \cdot (\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1) = (-7)(1) + (1)(0) + (13)(1) = 6\)
\(d = \left|\frac{6}{\sqrt{219}}\right| = \frac{6}{\sqrt{219}}\)
Hence the shortest distance between the lines is \(\frac{6}{\sqrt{219}}\) units (\(= \frac{2\sqrt{219}}{73}\) units).
Q6d.hi:
रेखाओं \(\vec{r} = \vec{a}_1 + \lambda \vec{b}_1\) तथा \(\vec{r} = \vec{a}_2 + \mu \vec{b}_2\) के बीच की न्यूनतम दूरी \(d = \left|\frac{(\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2) \cdot (\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1)}{|\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2|}\right|\) होती है।
पहली रेखा को \(\vec{r} = (\hat{i} + \hat{j}) + \lambda(-2\hat{i} - \hat{j} - \hat{k})\) लिखने पर,
\(\vec{a}_1 = \hat{i} + \hat{j}\), \(\vec{b}_1 = -2\hat{i} - \hat{j} - \hat{k}\), \(\vec{a}_2 = 2\hat{i} + \hat{j} + \hat{k}\), \(\vec{b}_2 = 3\hat{i} - 5\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}\)।
\(\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1 = \hat{i} + 0\hat{j} + \hat{k}\)
\(\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2 = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ -2 & -1 & -1 \\ 3 & -5 & 2 \end{vmatrix} = \hat{i}(-2 - 5) - \hat{j}(-4 + 3) + \hat{k}(10 + 3) = -7\hat{i} + \hat{j} + 13\hat{k}\)
\(|\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2| = \sqrt{49 + 1 + 169} = \sqrt{219}\)
\((\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2) \cdot (\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1) = (-7)(1) + (1)(0) + (13)(1) = 6\)
\(d = \left|\frac{6}{\sqrt{219}}\right| = \frac{6}{\sqrt{219}}\)
अतः रेखाओं के बीच की न्यूनतम दूरी \(\frac{6}{\sqrt{219}}\) इकाई (\(= \frac{2\sqrt{219}}{73}\) इकाई) है।

Q6e.en:
**Note:** The English print asks for the probability of becoming boy out of two children, which does not name an event clearly, while the Hindi print asks for the probability that both children are boys; the working follows the Hindi question, which is the complete one.

Write \(b\) for a boy and \(g\) for a girl. The sample space is \(S = \{bb, bg, gb, gg\}\), all four outcomes equally likely.
Let \(E\): both children are boys, so \(E = \{bb\}\).
Let \(F\): at least one child is a boy, so \(F = \{bb, bg, gb\}\).
Then \(E \cap F = \{bb\}\), and
\(P(F) = \frac{3}{4}\), \(P(E \cap F) = \frac{1}{4}\).
By conditional probability,
\(P(E / F) = \frac{P(E \cap F)}{P(F)} = \frac{\frac{1}{4}}{\frac{3}{4}} = \frac{1}{3}\).
Hence the probability that both children are boys, given that at least one is a boy, is \(\frac{1}{3}\).
If the English is read literally as the probability that at least one child is a boy, that event is the given condition \(F\) itself, so \(P(F / F) = 1\).
Q6e.hi:
**टिप्पणी:** अंग्रेज़ी प्रश्न में दो बच्चों में से लड़का होने की प्रायिकता पूछी गई है, जो घटना को स्पष्ट नहीं बताती, जबकि हिन्दी प्रश्न में दोनों बच्चों के लड़का होने की प्रायिकता पूछी गई है; हल हिन्दी प्रश्न के अनुसार है, जो पूर्ण है।

लड़के के लिए \(b\) तथा लड़की के लिए \(g\) लिखते हैं। प्रतिदर्श समष्टि \(S = \{bb, bg, gb, gg\}\) है, जिसके चारों परिणाम समसम्भाव्य हैं।
माना घटना \(E\): दोनों बच्चे लड़के हैं, अतः \(E = \{bb\}\)।
माना घटना \(F\): कम से कम एक बच्चा लड़का है, अतः \(F = \{bb, bg, gb\}\)।
तब \(E \cap F = \{bb\}\), तथा
\(P(F) = \frac{3}{4}\), \(P(E \cap F) = \frac{1}{4}\)।
सप्रतिबंध प्रायिकता से,
\(P(E / F) = \frac{P(E \cap F)}{P(F)} = \frac{\frac{1}{4}}{\frac{3}{4}} = \frac{1}{3}\)।
अतः कम से कम एक बच्चा लड़का होने पर दोनों बच्चों के लड़का होने की प्रायिकता \(\frac{1}{3}\) है।
यदि अंग्रेज़ी प्रश्न को शब्दशः कम से कम एक बच्चे के लड़का होने की प्रायिकता माना जाए, तो वह घटना स्वयं दिया गया प्रतिबंध \(F\) है, अतः \(P(F / F) = 1\)।

Q7a.en:
The given equation is \(x\cos\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)\frac{dy}{dx} = y\cos\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) + x\).
Dividing by \(x\cos\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)\):
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{y}{x} + \sec\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)\) ...(1)
Let \(F(x, y) = \frac{y}{x} + \sec\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)\). Then \(F(kx, ky) = \frac{y}{x} + \sec\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) = k^0 F(x, y)\), so \(F\) is homogeneous of degree zero and (1) is a homogeneous differential equation.
Put \(y = vx\), so that \(\frac{dy}{dx} = v + x\frac{dv}{dx}\).
Then (1) becomes
\(v + x\frac{dv}{dx} = v + \sec v\)
\(\Rightarrow x\frac{dv}{dx} = \sec v\)
\(\Rightarrow \cos v\, dv = \frac{dx}{x}\)
Integrating both sides:
\(\int \cos v\, dv = \int \frac{dx}{x}\)
\(\Rightarrow \sin v = \log|x| + C\), where \(C\) is an arbitrary constant.
Putting back \(v = \frac{y}{x}\):
\(\sin\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) = \log|x| + C\)
This is the general solution of the given differential equation.
Q7a.hi:
दिया गया अवकल समीकरण \(x\cos\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)\frac{dy}{dx} = y\cos\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) + x\) है।
\(x\cos\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)\) से भाग देने पर,
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{y}{x} + \sec\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)\) ...(1)
माना \(F(x, y) = \frac{y}{x} + \sec\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)\)। तब \(F(kx, ky) = \frac{y}{x} + \sec\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) = k^0 F(x, y)\), अतः \(F\) शून्य घात का समघातीय फलन है और (1) एक समघातीय अवकल समीकरण है।
\(y = vx\) रखने पर \(\frac{dy}{dx} = v + x\frac{dv}{dx}\)।
तब (1) से,
\(v + x\frac{dv}{dx} = v + \sec v\)
\(\Rightarrow x\frac{dv}{dx} = \sec v\)
\(\Rightarrow \cos v\, dv = \frac{dx}{x}\)
दोनों पक्षों का समाकलन करने पर,
\(\int \cos v\, dv = \int \frac{dx}{x}\)
\(\Rightarrow \sin v = \log|x| + C\), जहाँ \(C\) स्वेच्छ अचर है।
\(v = \frac{y}{x}\) पुनः रखने पर,
\(\sin\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) = \log|x| + C\)
यही दिए गए अवकल समीकरण का व्यापक हल है।

Q7b.en:
Take \(a, b > 0\). Let
\(I = \int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{x\, dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\) ...(1)
Using \(\int_{0}^{a} f(x)\, dx = \int_{0}^{a} f(a - x)\, dx\), and \(\cos^2(\pi - x) = \cos^2 x\), \(\sin^2(\pi - x) = \sin^2 x\):
\(I = \int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{(\pi - x)\, dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\) ...(2)
Adding (1) and (2):
\(2I = \pi\int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\)
The integrand \(g(x) = \frac{1}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\) satisfies \(g(\pi - x) = g(x)\), so \(\int_{0}^{\pi} g(x)\, dx = 2\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} g(x)\, dx\). Hence
\(2I = 2\pi\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\)
\(\Rightarrow I = \pi\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{\sec^2 x\, dx}{a^2 + b^2\tan^2 x}\) (dividing numerator and denominator by \(\cos^2 x\))
Put \(\tan x = t\), so \(\sec^2 x\, dx = dt\). When \(x = 0\), \(t = 0\); when \(x \to \frac{\pi}{2}\), \(t \to \infty\).
\(I = \pi\int_{0}^{\infty} \frac{dt}{a^2 + b^2t^2} = \frac{\pi}{b^2}\int_{0}^{\infty} \frac{dt}{\left(\frac{a}{b}\right)^2 + t^2}\)
\(= \frac{\pi}{b^2} \cdot \frac{b}{a}\left[\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{bt}{a}\right)\right]_{0}^{\infty} = \frac{\pi}{ab}\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - 0\right)\)
Hence \(I = \frac{\pi^2}{2ab}\).
Q7b.hi:
\(a, b > 0\) लेते हैं। माना
\(I = \int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{x\, dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\) ...(1)
गुणधर्म \(\int_{0}^{a} f(x)\, dx = \int_{0}^{a} f(a - x)\, dx\) तथा \(\cos^2(\pi - x) = \cos^2 x\), \(\sin^2(\pi - x) = \sin^2 x\) से,
\(I = \int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{(\pi - x)\, dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\) ...(2)
(1) तथा (2) को जोड़ने पर,
\(2I = \pi\int_{0}^{\pi} \frac{dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\)
समाकल्य \(g(x) = \frac{1}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\) के लिए \(g(\pi - x) = g(x)\), अतः \(\int_{0}^{\pi} g(x)\, dx = 2\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} g(x)\, dx\)। इसलिए
\(2I = 2\pi\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\)
\(\Rightarrow I = \pi\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} \frac{\sec^2 x\, dx}{a^2 + b^2\tan^2 x}\) (अंश और हर को \(\cos^2 x\) से भाग देने पर)
\(\tan x = t\) रखने पर \(\sec^2 x\, dx = dt\)। जब \(x = 0\), तब \(t = 0\); जब \(x \to \frac{\pi}{2}\), तब \(t \to \infty\)।
\(I = \pi\int_{0}^{\infty} \frac{dt}{a^2 + b^2t^2} = \frac{\pi}{b^2}\int_{0}^{\infty} \frac{dt}{\left(\frac{a}{b}\right)^2 + t^2}\)
\(= \frac{\pi}{b^2} \cdot \frac{b}{a}\left[\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{bt}{a}\right)\right]_{0}^{\infty} = \frac{\pi}{ab}\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - 0\right)\)
अतः \(I = \frac{\pi^2}{2ab}\)।

Q8a.en:
The ellipse \(\frac{x^2}{a^2} + \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1\) meets the \(x\)-axis at \((\pm a, 0)\) and the \(y\)-axis at \((0, \pm b)\), and it is symmetric about both axes. So the required area is 4 times the area in the first quadrant.
In the first quadrant \(y \geq 0\), so from the equation \(y = \frac{b}{a}\sqrt{a^2 - x^2}\), with \(x\) from \(0\) to \(a\).
Required area \(= 4\int_{0}^{a} y\, dx = 4\int_{0}^{a} \frac{b}{a}\sqrt{a^2 - x^2}\, dx\)
\(= \frac{4b}{a}\left[\frac{x}{2}\sqrt{a^2 - x^2} + \frac{a^2}{2}\sin^{-1}\frac{x}{a}\right]_{0}^{a}\)
\(= \frac{4b}{a}\left[\left(\frac{a}{2} \times 0 + \frac{a^2}{2}\sin^{-1} 1\right) - (0 + 0)\right]\)
\(= \frac{4b}{a} \cdot \frac{a^2}{2} \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} = \pi ab\)
Hence the area bounded by the ellipse is \(\pi ab\) square units.
Q8a.hi:
दीर्घवृत्त \(\frac{x^2}{a^2} + \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1\), \(x\)-अक्ष को \((\pm a, 0)\) पर तथा \(y\)-अक्ष को \((0, \pm b)\) पर काटता है, और दोनों अक्षों के सापेक्ष सममित है। अतः अभीष्ट क्षेत्रफल प्रथम चतुर्थांश के क्षेत्रफल का 4 गुना है।
प्रथम चतुर्थांश में \(y \geq 0\), अतः समीकरण से \(y = \frac{b}{a}\sqrt{a^2 - x^2}\), जहाँ \(x\) का मान \(0\) से \(a\) तक है।
अभीष्ट क्षेत्रफल \(= 4\int_{0}^{a} y\, dx = 4\int_{0}^{a} \frac{b}{a}\sqrt{a^2 - x^2}\, dx\)
\(= \frac{4b}{a}\left[\frac{x}{2}\sqrt{a^2 - x^2} + \frac{a^2}{2}\sin^{-1}\frac{x}{a}\right]_{0}^{a}\)
\(= \frac{4b}{a}\left[\left(\frac{a}{2} \times 0 + \frac{a^2}{2}\sin^{-1} 1\right) - (0 + 0)\right]\)
\(= \frac{4b}{a} \cdot \frac{a^2}{2} \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} = \pi ab\)
अतः दीर्घवृत्त से घिरे क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल \(\pi ab\) वर्ग इकाई है।

Q8b.en:
Let \(O\) be the centre of the sphere of radius \(R\). For the cone inscribed in the sphere, its vertex lies on the sphere, its axis passes through \(O\), and its base is a circle of the sphere. Let the base be at distance \(x\) from \(O\) on the side away from the vertex (\(0 \leq x < R\)).
Then the height of the cone is \(h = R + x\), and the radius \(r\) of its base satisfies \(r^2 = R^2 - x^2\) (right triangle formed by \(O\), the centre of the base and a point on the rim of the base).
Volume of the cone:
\(V = \frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h = \frac{1}{3}\pi(R^2 - x^2)(R + x)\)
Differentiating with respect to \(x\):
\(\frac{dV}{dx} = \frac{\pi}{3}\left[-2x(R + x) + (R^2 - x^2)\right] = \frac{\pi}{3}(R^2 - 2Rx - 3x^2) = \frac{\pi}{3}(R + x)(R - 3x)\)
For a maximum or minimum, \(\frac{dV}{dx} = 0\). Since \(R + x > 0\), this gives \(x = \frac{R}{3}\).
\(\frac{d^2V}{dx^2} = \frac{\pi}{3}(-2R - 6x)\), and at \(x = \frac{R}{3}\), \(\frac{d^2V}{dx^2} = \frac{\pi}{3}(-2R - 2R) = -\frac{4\pi R}{3} < 0\).
So \(V\) is maximum when \(x = \frac{R}{3}\), i.e. \(h = \frac{4R}{3}\) and \(r^2 = R^2 - \frac{R^2}{9} = \frac{8R^2}{9}\).
Maximum volume:
\(V_{\max} = \frac{1}{3}\pi \cdot \frac{8R^2}{9} \cdot \frac{4R}{3} = \frac{32\pi R^3}{81}\)
Volume of the sphere \(= \frac{4}{3}\pi R^3\), and
\(\frac{V_{\max}}{\frac{4}{3}\pi R^3} = \frac{32\pi R^3}{81} \times \frac{3}{4\pi R^3} = \frac{8}{27}\)
Hence the volume of the largest right circular cone inscribed in the sphere is \(\frac{8}{27}\) of the volume of the sphere.
Q8b.hi:
माना \(R\) त्रिज्या के गोले का केन्द्र \(O\) है। गोले के अंतर्गत शंकु का शीर्ष गोले पर है, उसका अक्ष \(O\) से होकर जाता है तथा उसका आधार गोले का एक वृत्त है। माना आधार, शीर्ष की विपरीत दिशा में \(O\) से \(x\) दूरी पर है (\(0 \leq x < R\))।
तब शंकु की ऊँचाई \(h = R + x\) है, और आधार की त्रिज्या \(r\) के लिए \(r^2 = R^2 - x^2\) (\(O\), आधार के केन्द्र तथा आधार की परिधि के एक बिंदु से बने समकोण त्रिभुज से)।
शंकु का आयतन:
\(V = \frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h = \frac{1}{3}\pi(R^2 - x^2)(R + x)\)
\(x\) के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर,
\(\frac{dV}{dx} = \frac{\pi}{3}\left[-2x(R + x) + (R^2 - x^2)\right] = \frac{\pi}{3}(R^2 - 2Rx - 3x^2) = \frac{\pi}{3}(R + x)(R - 3x)\)
उच्चिष्ठ या निम्निष्ठ के लिए \(\frac{dV}{dx} = 0\)। चूँकि \(R + x > 0\), अतः \(x = \frac{R}{3}\)।
\(\frac{d^2V}{dx^2} = \frac{\pi}{3}(-2R - 6x)\), तथा \(x = \frac{R}{3}\) पर \(\frac{d^2V}{dx^2} = \frac{\pi}{3}(-2R - 2R) = -\frac{4\pi R}{3} < 0\)।
अतः \(x = \frac{R}{3}\) पर \(V\) उच्चिष्ठ है, अर्थात \(h = \frac{4R}{3}\) तथा \(r^2 = R^2 - \frac{R^2}{9} = \frac{8R^2}{9}\)।
अधिकतम आयतन:
\(V_{\max} = \frac{1}{3}\pi \cdot \frac{8R^2}{9} \cdot \frac{4R}{3} = \frac{32\pi R^3}{81}\)
गोले का आयतन \(= \frac{4}{3}\pi R^3\), तथा
\(\frac{V_{\max}}{\frac{4}{3}\pi R^3} = \frac{32\pi R^3}{81} \times \frac{3}{4\pi R^3} = \frac{8}{27}\)
अतः गोले के अंतर्गत विशालतम लम्ब वृत्तीय शंकु का आयतन, गोले के आयतन का \(\frac{8}{27}\) होता है।

doubts.Q6e: English asks for 'the probability of becoming boy out of two children' (no clear event), Hindi asks for both children being boys; solved the Hindi reading, answer 1/3 (literal English reading 'at least one boy' given at least one boy is trivially 1).
doubts.Q6d: English prints a hat over lambda (read as the scalar lambda); as printed (first line i+j - lambda(2i+j+k), second through 2i+j+k) the distance is 6/sqrt(219); the familiar NCERT version (i+j)+lambda(2i-j+k), (2i+j-k)+mu(3i-5j+2k) gives 10/sqrt(59), so the print may carry misprints.
doubts.Q5d: Not a defect but worth a look: the constraints x+y>=8 and 3x+5y<=15 (x,y>=0) have no common region, so the answer is 'no feasible region, no minimum' (as in the NCERT example with these constraints).
